description: Test helper functions and setup code for Mattermost channel jobs, including test environment setup, user and team creation, job management, and worker control.

classes.name: TestHelper
classes.description: Helper class for setting up and managing test environment, users, teams, jobs, and workers in Mattermost channel jobs testing.

methods.name: setupTestHelper
methods.description: Initializes a test environment with configuration, logger, server, and cleanup routines.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Sets up a test environment with default options.

methods.name: SetupWithUpdateCfg
methods.description: Sets up a test environment with optional configuration updates.

methods.name: InitBasic
methods.description: Initializes basic users, roles, and team for testing.

methods.name: CreateTeam
methods.description: Creates a new team for testing.

methods.name: CreateUser
methods.description: Creates a new user for testing.

methods.name: CreateUserOrGuest
methods.description: Creates a user or guest user for testing.

methods.name: ShutdownApp
methods.description: Shuts down the server and cleans up resources.

methods.name: SetupBatchWorker
methods.description: Registers and runs a batch worker for testing.

methods.name: WaitForJobStatus
methods.description: Waits until a job reaches a specified status.

methods.name: WaitForBatchNumber
methods.description: Waits until a job reaches a specific batch number.

methods.name: RunJob
methods.description: Creates and waits for a job to complete successfully.

methods.name: checkJobStatus
methods.description: Polls until a job reaches the desired status.
